title: Been Dope delivers a masterpiece titled “Lean”
htmlContent:
American-based lyrical genius, Been Dope is a talented rapper, singer, and songwriter currently making solid waves in the music scene. Been Dope’s flag in the contemporary hip-hop scene as a technically-gifted rapper and a fully-realized artist and songwriter. This talent is on full display in his recent song “Lean.”

Been Dope’s “Lean” is an incredible vocal performance that’s big enough to take us to its rightful destination. The layers in the music allow your mind to wander and explore this world of creation he brings to us, with a track that sounds like a new frontier that we have made it to.
